_status: Learner guide, Try it 1.1A and its model answers (19 October 2026). The column is what each asset's most likely threat hits first; the reason gives the threat and one thing to do.

items.why: Data theft using stolen passwords. Do: MFA and access only for staff who need it.
E-wallet numbers changed by a fraudster or insider. Do: two-person approval and call-back before any change.
Ransomware, or traffic floods that crash it. Do: tested backups and a continuity plan.
Phishing: Secret, then everything the account can reach. Do: MFA, a report button, training.
Defacement. Do: updates, a protected admin page, monitoring.
Ransomware reaching the backups, or theft: Ready, and Secret if stolen. Do: an offline copy, encryption, regular restore tests.
